caption:
Sold your Dhanteras gold within 2 years? How much tax?

Illustrative: a ₹20,000 gain on physical gold (coins, bars, jewellery) sold within 24 months is short-term.
It's added to your income and taxed at your slab: at 30% + 4% cess, that's ₹6,240.
Held more than 24 months, the same gain is long-term: 12.5% + 4% cess = ₹2,600, no indexation.
Surcharge not included; lower slabs pay less.

Did you know gold had two different tax rates?
Send this to the friend who bought gold this Dhanteras.

Sources: a personal-finance magazine's Jan 2026 guide to gold and silver tax by holding period; a tax-filing site's guide to tax on gold. Illustrative maths only.
